extraction.name: AMASS
extraction.description: AMASS is a large database of human motion that unifies 15 different optical marker-based mocap datasets by representing them within a common framework and parameterization. It contains more than 40 hours of motion data, spanning over 300 subjects and more than 11,000 motions.
extraction.creator: Naureen Mahmood (Meshcapade GmbH); Nima Ghorbani (MPI for Intelligent Systems); Nikolaus F. Troje (York University); Gerard Pons-Moll (MPI for Informatics); Michael J. Black (MPI for Intelligent Systems)
extraction.citeAs: Naureen Mahmood, Nima Ghorbani, Nikolaus F. Troje, Gerard Pons-Moll, Michael J. Black. AMASS: Archive of Motion Capture as Surface Shapes. arXiv:1904.03278, 2019.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was assembled by combining 15 existing motion capture datasets. Publicly available datasets were downloaded from the internet, several others were obtained privately, and new datasets (Dancers, Transitions, BioMotionLab, and SSM) were recorded by the authors using an optical motion capture system synchronized with a 4D scanning system.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis; Physical data collection
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: During motion capture sessions, markers may get occluded by the body due to pose, resulting in missing markers in a given frame. The data also contained inherent motion capture problems such as swapped and mislabeled markers.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The raw data consists of 15 optical marker-based motion capture datasets containing varying markersets ranging in size from 37 to 91 markers, as well as dense 3D meshes in motion captured with a 4D scanner synchronized with traditional marker-based mocap.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Marker data was mapped into common SMPL pose, shape, and soft-tissue parameters using MoSh++, and the results were manually inspected to correct or hold out problems such as swapped and mislabeled markers.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset contains 4D scan data and synchronized mocap data of subjects wearing minimal clothing; two subjects were professional models who signed modeling contracts allowing the release of their data.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Animation; visualization; generating training data for deep learning; computer vision
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset is available at http://amass.is.tue.mpg.de, and the authors will continuously incorporate more mocap data contributed by themselves and the community.
extraction.rai:dataImputationProtocol: In cases where there are no markers present on the hands of the recorded subjects, the hand poses are set to the average pose of the MANO model.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Due to inherent problems with mocap, such as swapped and mislabeled markers, we manually inspected the results and either corrected or held out problems.
